review_description: Salesman told a lot of lies - system is cheap rubbish and i paid huge money for quality.Can never trust a solar salesman again.Hot water system was installed on wrong section of house so it is mostly shaded with no sun.I was told that i would not receive another power bill, this is impossible if you are connected to the grid as you must pay a daily access charge.When I phoned their office I was given the runaround.For a good job this company has closed down.I hope they are never allowed to operate another business again.
Have not had it on long enough to make a comment yet on savings or experience.
